title: MathChat
description: Make math operations directly in your Minecraft chat!
body:
This mod adds the possibility to do math operations directly in the chat of your server

Make math operations directly in your Minecraft chat!

To do a math operation, just type ! before the math operation:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23ce7e88a2167fbba687cd5ee4c57b3f83ea774.png)
